data.name: Isitha
data.gender_notes: Isitha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Isitha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Isana’ which means god and ‘Ishita’ which means worshipped or revered. The name Isitha is believed to be the name of the goddess of wisdom and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, she is depicted as the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. The name Isitha carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Isitha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Isitha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isitha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
